adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug. Looking at lines 1060-1067 in handleNewBooking.ts, when `eventType.destinationCalendar` is falsy AND `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is also falsy, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null`. Then at lines 1074-1076, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` which uses optional chaining - if `destinationCalendar` is `null`, the push operation is skipped entirely. This means for collective team events where the organizer has no destination calendar but other team members do have destination calendars, those team member calendars will never be added because the push on null does nothing. The fix should initialize to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` when both are falsy.
